label: COL27A1+
evidence: Azimuth human_tonsil_v2 fine annotation 'COL27A1+' (order 67), derived from King HW et al. 2021 Sci Immunol (DOI 10.1126/sciimmunol.abh3768). The label names COL27A1 (collagen type XXVII alpha-1) as a discriminating transcript for a stromal follicular dendritic cell (FDC) subset of the germinal center. ASTA indexes only the atlas ABSTRACT (CorpusId 238530091), so the resolved name and biological placement (FDC subset showing zonal light-zone/dark-zone heterogeneity) are supported from the broader FDC literature rather than the atlas full text.
